historical_reviews.deepseek: The passive SDR query is directionally relevant, but the broad pattern cannot establish lower-bank physical membership, distinguish status from speed or prove completeness after a 60-line cap.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly rejects full automation and requires complete SDR, Sensor List and Web comparison. This review makes lower-bank attribution and discrete-versus-analog semantics explicit.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code variant exists; adjacent STATUS_UP_FAN and STATUS_PSU rows remain separate test identities.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires every range member to be evidenced; ED-36 treats topology and sensor semantics as readiness inputs; ED-38 preserves logs and engineer verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: Verify every required lower-fan status channel for the switch-board cooling domain, including correct physical membership, sensor identity and description, status-or-reading semantics and agreement across SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The cooling owner expands 1~N into actual lower-bank fan positions and stable SDR records, defines whether each record is discrete presence/fault/status or analog RPM, supplies expected values and Web mapping, and automation then collects complete passive IPMI evidence for per-member comparison.
manual_activity: The cooling/platform owner maps lower-bank fan positions to sensor records, defines status/RPM semantics and expected values and confirms the BMC-Web rows. No fan manipulation or active fault is authorized.
required_inputs: Switch-board/chassis cooling topology and definition of the lower fan bank
Installed lower-fan positions and exact 1~N membership/applicability
Per-position stable SDR name/record/entity and BMC-Web row
Whether each channel is discrete presence/fault/status, RPM or another reading
Expected normal state/value, units, tolerance, unavailable/stale semantics and update interval
BMC/SDR/fan-controller firmware versions and polling/rounding allowances
Protected in-band/OOB collection path and credential policy
Thermal/fan abort thresholds, log-retention policy and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Match this exact row and variant; do not infer LOW_FAN coverage from the adjacent UP_FAN row
Do not assume every FAN or RPM row belongs to STATUS_LOW_FAN 1~N
Enumerate and report every required member separately; one representative fan cannot pass the range
Retain complete SDR and Sensor List output before filtering; no 60-line cap
Do not change PWM/mode, stop fans, inject faults, reset BMC or clear logs
Protect credentials and stop on missing/stale/invalid status, fan loss, thermal rise or BMC instability
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and lower-bank topology
Capture complete read-only SDR and Sensor List inventories
Resolve each owner-approved lower-fan member and normalize status/RPM semantics
Build per-member SDR/Sensor parity and prepare exact Web rows for operator confirmation
Perform no fan control, physical action, fault injection or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the 1~N physical and sensor membership
Define discrete/analog semantics, expected values and freshness rules
Approve BMC-Web mapping and unavailable/absent handling
Review every channel and issue the overall result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only `sdr list` can contribute raw evidence, but FAN/LOW_FAN/RPM plus `head -n 60` is overinclusive and incomplete, exposes credentials and omits complete Sensor List and Web parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through approved secret-safe access, retain complete SDR and Sensor List outputs, select only owner-enumerated lower-fan records, compare each name/description/status-or-reading with its specification and correlate the exact BMC-Web row.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: STATUS_LOW_FAN 1~N, the BMC-Web check, all three criteria and 3/3-minute estimates are preserved; membership, sensor type and values are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES LOWER-FAN MEMBERSHIP AND SENSOR SEMANTICS PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map physical lower fans to exact SDR records, collect complete inventories at aligned timestamps, normalize discrete status versus RPM readings, verify all members across IPMI and Web and retain thermal health without stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the range and three-view comparison executable without performing the source's destructive generic log clear.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A broad filtered list can include upper fans or omit lower channels; an RPM value does not automatically satisfy a discrete status criterion, and Web visibility alone cannot prove SDR correctness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Collection is passive, but false-normal interpretation can conceal cooling loss; stopping a fan would exceed this case and create thermal risk.

project_override_considerations: Platforms without a distinct lower bank require an explicit topology mapping or not-applicable decision. Sensor renames need a versioned physical-to-SDR/Web crosswalk rather than substring matching.
expected_evidence: Per-member SDR record/entity, sensor type, units/state/value/freshness and Web mapping
Versioned expected sensor and thermal specification
Complete redacted raw SDR and Sensor List output with status/timestamps
Per-member normalized comparison and missing/extra/duplicate/stale analysis
Timestamped Web evidence plus passive RPM/temperature/BMC/SEL/OS health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master test set, Items and criteria consistently describe lower-fan sensor-list coverage. The procedure is incomplete and includes a generic destructive setup step, but it does not select a contradictory target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The lower-fan monitoring purpose and passive evidence path are identifiable. Membership, semantics and expected values are project-supplied readiness inputs under ED-36, not an irreducible identity conflict.

review_improvement: Turns an ambiguous 1~N label into a lower-bank physical per-sensor completeness matrix and prevents RPM readings, upper-fan rows or truncated filters from substituting for the requested status coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: The word `STATUS` does not establish whether each channel is a discrete presence/fault state or a numeric tachometer reading. Lower-bank identity must therefore be derived from approved topology and stable SDR entity mapping, not a case-insensitive name match. Complete read-only inventories allow all members to be reconciled across SDR, Sensor List and Web while preserving cooling and log state.
